rows.en: "Flag 1B0 has not been set. To play this private
event, set flag 1B0 and try again.
Otherwise, the event will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
I wonder if someone's on it."
Touya: "Of course people use it."
Yamato: "But whenever I see it, it's always stopped.
And right on that floor, too."
Touya: "You're imagining it. Imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahaha!
To protect the one I love, my blade of justice strikes the enemy!
With red blood burning crimson, such is the way a man must live!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I have arrived! For justice... I can die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to all the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You should have Gabon take a look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I am the very picture of health!
I'm not so weak that I'd get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...So, how was it? I'm quite confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It wasn't bad at all.
Sounds like enka.
Fain: "Doesn't it? That last part in particular
gives even me a thrill when I say it."
Yamato: "He's intoxicated with himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep it up."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... If I had to describe it, maybe 'a song of the Japanese
heart'?"
Fain: "Heart? You mean a song that resonates
directly with the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my proclamation
is that wonderful too!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice is also for protecting the people dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. People dear to you, eh..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice
is not so fickle! Oh, what am I to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "We'd better stay away..."
Fain: "But we're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I've decided in my heart to love only one woman.
And yet, I have the noble, supreme duty
of protecting the princess. I can abandon neither loyalty nor love.
Ah... What an ordeal! Such is the destiny of a knight!
Then I shall press on! To fight against fate!
No, wait. But my master also said that wanting too much at once
is the same as losing everything.
Does that mean I must commit myself to one or the other?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And to choose between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it! All of this is because those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If they weren't around, I would never have had to
suffer like this...
Wait! Could this be their plot?!
Grrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not let something like that
break my spirit! Hmm? Does that mean,
to turn their plan against them, I must preserve my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess,
all at the same time?
No, but that would go against my master's teaching.
Aaaah! What am I supposed to doooo?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has it rough too."
Touya: "Well, I guess his life's pretty fulfilling in its own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan..."
Ymir: "Perfect timing. I was going to show Kasumi to her room,
but could you do it for me?
I can't leave my seat right now..."
Touya: "Her room?"
Ymir: "Yes. The room where Kasumi will be staying.
We've only done a little with the interior, but it's ready,
so she should be able to use it right away."
Touya: "Hmm. So where is it?"
Ymir: "In the first section of the third level..."
Touya: "...Which means where?"
Yamato: "Oh, I knyow.
It's right opposite Touya's room, isn't it?"
Ymir: "Yes. I'll leave it to you, then."
Kasumi: "Thank you.
Touya-chan, Yamato-chan, let's go."
Yamato: "Yeah! Off we go!"
Ymir: "Aren't you going?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah... See you, then."
Ymir: "Yes."
Yamato: "Here it is."
Kasumi: "Well then..."
Touya: "Hmm? Is something wrong?"
Kasumi: "Why aren't you coming in?"
Touya: "Huh? Is that okay?"
Kasumi: "Why wouldn't it be? Don't be shy. Come in."
Yamato: "Well then..."
Touya: "Excuse us..."
Touya: "Hmm... It's pretty nice, isn't it?"
Kasumi: "Yeah. They've already helped me so much,
and they've even prepared a room like this..."
Touya: "Well, now that I think about it, a room each
is pretty good treatment. And meals included, too."
Kasumi: "Honestly, Touya-chan..."
Yamato: "Hey, Kasumi, you didn't bring any changes of clothes, did you?"
Kasumi: "No. But Mr. Bart said he'd get some for me."
Touya: "Come to think of it, Ai had him get her a camera
too, didn't she...?"
Yamato: "...Couldn't Bart make a living
doing that sort of thing?"
Touya: "Anyway, in that case,
there shouldn't be any problems for now."
Kasumi: "That's right. Oh, right.
Can I come and visit your room sometime, Touya-chan?"
Touya: "Huh? Sure, I don't mind..."
Kasumi: "It's in the section right opposite
this room, isn't it?"
Yamato: "Ding-ding! That's Kasumi for you.
Your brain works better than Touya's."
Touya: "Well, excuse me."
Kasumi: "Heh heh heh. I'll look forward to visiting, then."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "Touya, Kasumi probably wants to rest,
so let's get going."
Touya: "Hmm? Yeah, you're right."
Kasumi: "Come and visit anytime."
Touya: "Yeah. See you, then."
